required_behavior: An in-bounds unary read applies its primitive to the raw stored real-carrier value, including a predicate source. Neither boolToTropical nor realToBool applies under unary.
A tropical OOB unary read returns reduceId directly, without invoking the primitive; OOB log or reciprocal therefore does not raise a domain error there.
A real/Boolean OOB unary read invokes the primitive on native +0: exp/cos give 1, sin/sqrt give +0, and log/reciprocal fail.
Domain checks are log v<=0, sqrt v<0, reciprocal v==0. Both signed zeros fail log and reciprocal; sqrt(-0) is admitted.
NaN makes all three rejection predicates false, so it is admitted to the native primitive and yields NaN rather than a unary-domain error.

log(+infinity) and sqrt(+infinity) succeed; log/sqrt(-infinity) fail; reciprocal of either infinity succeeds with signed zero. exp/sin/cos are unchecked native operations, including their nonfinite outcomes.

The generic checked gather would apply a flag before unary if a malformed raw read combined them, but checkAssignCore rejects every flagged unary read; this is not an admitted checked/reference discrepancy.

required_behavior: f64 destinations admit exactly real, max-plus and min-plus f64 algebras. f32 destinations admit their three native-f32 counterparts. Bool destinations admit only admittedAlgebraBool in either carrier.
Identity matching is structural over ScalarConst bit patterns; substituting -0 for a required +0 algebra identity is not admitted.
boolToTropical=true is admitted only for a bare bool-source read under add-factor/max-or-min-reduction algebra.
realToBool=true is admitted only for a bare non-bool-source read under the exact Boolean algebra.
Both flags cannot be simultaneously admitted, because their source/algebra requirements conflict.

False flags are not rejected merely because source/destination tags would lead the source compiler to set one. Thus an arbitrary checked raw plan can intentionally omit a cast, and its serialized flag must be obeyed rather than re-inferred.
The source compiler sets the appropriate flags on bare reads, and leaves both false on unary reads.
Within one carrier a source dtype need not equal destination dtype; a bool source feeding real storage is permitted.

ContractionAlgebra contains only factorOp/factorId/reduceOp/reduceId. ScalarBinOp contains add/mul/min/max. Neither contains associative, commutative, distributive, absorbing-zero or parallel-scan law flags/certificates. No optimization permission follows from these records.

required_behavior: StateInit.zero fills every complete-history cell with native +0. negInf fills -infinity; posInf fills +infinity. Base writes then overlay; untouched cells retain that initial value.

Source max-plus states select negInf, min-plus states posInf, and real/Boolean states zero. A sort-neutral base adopts its state's sort for gathering, casts and algebra, rather than evaluating as ordinary real sum-product.
checkScanCore admits both carrier kinds via checkScanPlan/checkScanPlanF32, and permits bool states alongside that carrier's real states.
A bool state with negInf/posInf is stateInitNotAdmitted. A real-carrier state may structurally name any StateInit, but direct assignment writers must agree with it via checkStateInitTie.
For every directly producing .assign in base and step writes, add/max requires negInf, add/min requires posInf, and real/Boolean requires zero. A mismatch is stateInitAlgebraMismatch.

The init tie does not trace through pointwise/axiswise output steps or a pass-through block input; those impose no assignment-algebra tie at that check. Do not claim a stronger global semantic-sort proof for arbitrary raw scans.
No states or no advancing axes are refused. Each advancing history extent must be >0; extent 0 is zeroExtent, not an empty accepted scan. Extent 1 yields zero successor steps along that axis.
Non-advancing zero extents are not banned by the scan's history-extent check; the dense shape equations can yield an empty state buffer.

The checker also enforces completeHistory, axisZeroFastest, zeroThenBaseOverlay, immutablePreStep, writer geometry/disjointness and captured-state causality. It does not establish associativity or authorize parallel scan.
